nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.eicab.eicab_masks
========================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.eicab.eicab_masks

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Resolve eICAB Circle-of-Willis (CW) or whole-brain (WB) multilabel masks.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: EicabMaskKind

.. py:data:: CENTERLINES_MASK_PP_NIFTI
   :value: 'centerlines_mask_pp.nii.gz'


.. py:class:: EicabMaskResolution

   Result of :func:`resolve_eicab_mask`.


   .. py:attribute:: path
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: requested
      :type:  EicabMaskKind


   .. py:attribute:: used
      :type:  EicabMaskKind


   .. py:attribute:: fallback
      :type:  bool


   .. py:attribute:: fallback_reason
      :type:  str | None


   .. py:attribute:: postprocessed
      :type:  bool
      :value: False



   .. py:attribute:: original_path
      :type:  pathlib.Path | None
      :value: None



.. py:function:: eicab_pp_path(original: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path

   Post-processed mask path: ``foo_eICAB_CW.nii.gz`` → ``foo_eICAB_CW_pp.nii.gz``.


.. py:function:: find_tof_resampled_volume(eicab_output_dir: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Return path to eICAB ``TOF_resampled`` NIfTI under *eicab_output_dir*, or None.


.. py:function:: resolve_eicab_mask(eicab_dir: pathlib.Path, preference: EicabMaskKind = 'cw', *, prefer_postprocessed: bool = True) -> EicabMaskResolution

   Return the eICAB label NIfTI path for *preference*, with warn-and-fallback.

   When *prefer_postprocessed* is True and a ``*_pp`` sibling of the base mask exists,
   that post-processed file is returned (``postprocessed=True``).
